vitals.assistant.title: Vitals assistant
vitals.assistant.subtitle: Dictate the measurements, review them, then save.
vitals.assistant.example: “Temperature 38.4, blood pressure 132 over 84, oxygen saturation 96, pulse 104, weight 73 kilos.”
vitals.assistant.micUnsupported: The microphone is not available in this browser. Use text entry instead.
vitals.assistant.micError: Microphone access failed. Check your browser permissions.
vitals.assistant.processingBackground: Joprelys is processing the latest information. You can continue the consultation.
vitals.assistant.error: Joprelys could not analyze these vital signs. Try again or enter them manually.
vitals.assistant.reviewNotice: No form value changes until you explicitly apply the proposal.
vitals.assistant.realtimeRecoveryHelp: Wait until listening is restored before dictating new measurements.
vitals.assistant.realtimeDisconnectedHel: Use manual entry while listening is unavailable.
vitals.assistant.realtimeHelp: Dictate vital signs naturally. Values remain proposals until you validate them.
vitals.assistant.realtimeProcessingBackg: Processing in the background — keep dictating.
vitals.assistant.realtimeDurableBlocked: Secure persistence is interrupted. Realtime is paused; use manual entry without closing this screen.
vitals.assistant.realtimeLowConfidenceRe: Uncertain transcript: values remain proposals for review and nothing is saved automatically.
vitals.assistant.realtimeUnavailable: Realtime is temporarily unavailable. Automatic reconnection is in progress.
vitals.assistant.realtimeUnsupported: This browser does not support the real-time audio connection.
vitals.assistant.realtimeConsent: The microphone opens only after you enable this mode and stops when you leave it.
vitals.entry.appliedNotice: Values have been transferred to the fields. Review them, then save the vital signs.
vitals.entry.manual.title: Manual entry
vitals.entry.manual.help: Enter or correct measurements in the fields below. No microphone is needed.
vitals.entry.dictation.title: Dictation
vitals.entry.dictation.help: Start dictation, say the measurements, then stop to analyze. Check the proposed values before transferring them to the form.
vitals.entry.realtime.title: Continuous listening
vitals.entry.realtime.help: Start the microphone when ready. Measurements are proposed as you dictate; stop listening before saving.
vitals.entry.dictationUnavailable: Dictation is unavailable in this browser. Use the fields or text entry.
vitals.entry.recordingHelp: Say the values and their units, then stop to review the proposal.
vitals.entry.measurementsHelp: Check values and units before saving. Fields contain the previous measurement when available.
vitals.entry.finishBeforeSave: Finish capture and wait for analysis to complete before saving.
vitals.entry.saveNotice: The values above will be saved after your confirmation.
